candidate_substrate: Trajectory-Informed Memory Generation for Self-Improving Agent Systems (IBM Research)

construct_match.trajectory_outcome_semantics: ground-truth benchmark success/failure is used when available; otherwise the trajectory intelligence stage infers success/failure/recovered from execution and reflection signals
construct_match.assessment: At the generated-entry level this is the cleanest audited external process-provenance schema: the source trajectory and its outcome are explicit attributes of reusable guidance.

examples: strategy tips are generated from clean successful executions
recovery tips are generated from failure/recovery patterns
optimization tips are generated from successful but inefficient executions
content_channel_confounds.consolidation_rule: conflict resolution uses tip category, priority, and source trajectory success/failure status; successful-source tips take precedence over failed-source tips
content_channel_confounds.implication: The native pipeline is an L1-like writer/consolidation bundle. A source-outcome field cannot be causally isolated by simply comparing native stored tips because provenance can alter tip content and which tip survives merging.

storage_and_runtime_visibility.assessment: The paper proves source-outcome provenance exists during generation and consolidation, but does not establish that it survives as a first-class stored field after consolidation or is visible to the executor.

support_gate.external_code_finders: bounded search surfaces show Request Code / paper-only coverage; non-author replications are not source authority
requirements_before_any_l2_reopen: author/first-party code or a source-faithful artifact bundle is released and pinned
pre-consolidation and post-consolidation memory schemas are inspected
source outcome must be shown to survive as a separately addressable field, or a prospectively justified pre-consolidation memory object must be selected
runtime prompt/disclosure path must support exposing source outcome without changing tip bytes, selection, rank/order, or any other evidence
fresh independent exact-information units must be enumerated before any treatment outcomes

exact_information_pair_gate.required_object: A prospectively selected pair or deterministic canonical memory object with byte-identical actionable guidance across true success/failure source-provenance conditions. Native outcome-conditioned generation or outcome-aware consolidation cannot be used as proof of information identity.
exact_information_pair_gate.preferred_source_level_route_if_code_app: Inspect pre-consolidation generated entries first, because post-consolidation conflict resolution explicitly uses source outcome and can change canonical content.
forbidden: compare native success-derived versus failure-derived tips and call it metadata-only
toggle source outcome after content was selected using that same outcome field without freezing an exact-information object
allow consolidation or retrieval to choose different tips between metadata arms
use non-author reimplementations as source-faithful evidence
select pairs based on downstream treatment outcomes

prospective_execution_contract_if_suppor.independent_unit: fresh downstream AppWorld-style task under a prospectively frozen exact-information memory pair/object
held_fixed: prompt position and all non-provenance bytes
prospective_execution_contract_if_suppor.treatment: only a separately serialized valid source-trajectory success versus failure provenance field
prospective_execution_contract_if_suppor.sample_size: must be justified independently using B1 prospective power planning; the R5 10-task support floor is not a power guarantee

decision.fallback_if_source_outcome_does_not_surv: Retain IBM as strong evidence that source-outcome provenance is an explicit memory-generation object, but do not execute it as B1 exact L2.
decision.strongest_allowed_current_statement: The IBM framework explicitly attaches source trajectory and source outcome description to generated memory entries, making it a strong construct match, but source outcome also affects consolidation and is not shown in the published runtime prompt fields; without first-party code, no exact-information metadata-only execution is currently justified.
